icedq: CATEGORIES (all read on icedq.com on 2026-11-15): etl-testing-tools YES https://icedq.com/etl-testing-tools ; data-reconciliation-tools YES https://icedq.com/data-reconciliation-tool ; bi-report-testing-tools YES https://icedq.com/bi-report-testing-tool ; power-bi-report-testing-tools YES https://icedq.com/power-bi-report-testing-tool ; file-testing-tools YES https://icedq.com/file-testing-tool ; data-monitoring-testing-tools YES https://icedq.com/product/data-monitoring-tool and https://icedq.com/products/data-observability-tool ; data-quality-tools YES https://icedq.com/features (profiling, rule checks, ML anomaly detection; no cleansing) ; api-testing-tools YES, borderline https://icedq.com/api-data-testing-tool. The page is titled 'API Testing & Monitoring with iceDQ' and says 'iceDQ tests REST, OData, and GraphQL APIs'. It lists API status and health checks (HTTP 2xx/4xx/5xx assertions, OAuth2/API key and 401 handling, 403 RBAC, 429 rate limits, latency SLA) plus OpenAPI/JSON Schema contract validation, so testing APIs is stated as a capability and not only reading them as a source. But its focus is the data in responses, and its FAQ says 'Functional tools test whether an API responds correctly. iceDQ tests whether the data in the response is correct'; the editor may drop this category. PRICING: no pricing page (icedq.com/pricing returns 404). The overview FAQ says 'It's a consumption-based license per user per server or enterprise.' Every CTA is 'Book a Demo'. The homepage 'Free Trial' card ('Install iceDQ Platform in your own premise or cloud environment...') links to /request-a-demo, which gives no trial terms. Third-party listings (Capterra: 'starting from $1,000 per user/month') were NOT used because the vendor does not publish them. DEPLOYMENT: overview FAQ says 'SaaS option on AWS or the self-managed on-premises options'; features page says 'SaaS, On-premises, Cloud, more…'. The licensing policy defines an instance as a bare-metal server, VM or container. CONNECTOR COUNT: connectors and data-testing pages say 150+; the ETL page says 100+. LICENSING: the licensing policy splits connectors into standard (Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Excel, flat file and others) and premium add-on (JSON, XML, Parquet, Avro, REST API, GraphQL, OData, Salesforce, Kafka, Power BI XMLA). Premium BI report connectors: Power BI, Tableau Cloud, Qlik Cloud, SAP WebI. Premium integrations: Xray, Zephyr, Azure DevOps, Jira, Webhook, GitHub Actions. BI: the BI testing FAQ names Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, MicroStrategy, SAP BusinessObjects and IBM Cognos. The connectors page lists Business Objects, MicroStrategy, Power BI, Power BI XMLA, Qlik Cloud, Tableau Cloud, SAP WEBI and Analysis Services, but not Cognos or Looker. FEATURE NOTES: regressionTesting=true is based on the BI page's 'Report vs. report: Compare a report against another version of itself - across environments (dev, test, prod)... to confirm nothing changed that shouldn't have' and the Power BI page's 'Reconcile values between two reports—across environments, versions'. The word 'regression' itself appears only on the ETL page ('regression packs'). performanceTesting=null: no report load or render performance testing is mentioned. cleansing=false: the API page FAQ says 'iceDQ only reads and evaluates data... It never changes data'. openSource=false: commercial EULA-licensed product with no open-source edition shown. alerts: features page says 'via email, Teams, or Slack'. Freshness and volume checks and the 'lineage module' are on the data observability page. loadTesting and mocking=null: not mentioned. COMPLIANCE: the site footer shows badges whose image files are iso-27001.png (alt 'ISO/IEC') and AIPC-SOC.png (alt 'SOC/AICPA'), linking to trust.icedq.com, which returned 403. The SOC report type is not stated in visible text; commented-out HTML shows 'Type 2' under the ISO badge, so I did not use it. COMPANY: Torana Inc.; HQ '60 Long Ridge Road, Suite 303, Stamford CT 06902' (site footer and about page). Founded year is not stated on icedq.com. LinkedIn returned 403. Third-party profiles say 2005, but this is unverified, so founded is null. An 'iceDQ Standard & Big Data Editions' video page is dated 2018 (upload) and is not a current edition list, so it was not used for plans.
